summary: Comprehensive testing of OpenAI API Key support for voice transcription (Whisper). All 9 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. The Settings page correctly shows the 'Voice Dictation (AI Transcription)' section with API key input, show/hide toggle, and save functionality. The AI Consultation page loads correctly with demo mode working.

issues: Microphone access denied message shows in headless browser - expected behavior for automated testing

Backend: OpenAI API key persists after save (verified via GET)
Backend: POST /api/dictation/transcribe requires authentication (returns 401/403)
Backend: POST /api/dictation/transcribe returns 400 with 'API key not configured' when no key set
Backend: POST /api/dictation/transcribe returns meaningful error for invalid API key
Backend: POST /api/dictation/sessions creates session successfully
Backend: POST /api/dictation/structure processes transcript and returns structured SOAP data

Frontend: Can type in OpenAI API Key field

Frontend: Show/hide toggle changes input type from password to text
